items.name: Brincos Dieras
items.caption:
Mexico’s “El Payaso Más Irreverente” is back on his U.S. comedy run.
Brincos Dieras performs at Arena Theatre on February 6, 2027. His adult-oriented clown comedy is known for crowd work and Spanish-language punchlines. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
